Live Cross-Device Sync

Auto-sync page position & notes across Windows, iPad & iPhone

Run the Windows Wi-Fi launcher to auto-sync on home Wi-Fi
Zero accounts, $0 forever — syncs over your home Wi-Fi:
  1. Unzip apple-books-wifi-sync.zip on your Windows PC and double-click Start-Books-WiFi.bat.
  2. Your PC will show a Wi-Fi link (like 192.168.1.x:8765) and open Books on Windows.
  3. Open that same link in Safari on your iPad & iPhone (tap Share → Add to Home Screen). Every page turn, highlight, and bookmark syncs live automatically.
Not connected — running locally
How to get your free $0 database URL (2 min setup)
  1. Go to console.firebase.google.com (free Spark plan, no card needed) and click Create a project.
  2. In the left menu, open Build → Realtime Database → Create Database (start in test mode).
  3. Copy the https://...firebaseio.com URL, paste it above with your Sync Key on Windows, iPad, and iPhone, and tap Connect Live Sync.
Export a snapshot file or copy a Sync Code to move your reading position, highlights, notes, bookmarks, and goals without any cloud account.
